kycStillWaiting: Still waiting on DigiLocker. You can check back from here later.
kycIntro: Customers let you into their homes, so we verify every worker's identity through DigiLocker, the Government of India's document platform. Nothing is uploaded — you just approve the request on your own Aadhaar account.
kycPrivacy: Your Aadhaar details are confirmed directly with DigiLocker. We store only what proves the check happened — never your photo or a copy of your Aadhaar.
kycAwaitingConsent: Complete the DigiLocker consent in your browser, then come back here.
